//: Universal Agent Kit permission template for Claude Code. Review it before adopting; tighten it to taste.
allow: file reads and edits, plus the git commands that only stage, commit or move between branches.
Read-only git (status, log, diff, show) needs no rule - Claude Code approves it already.
Never widen this to Bash(git *): that pre-approves force push, hard reset, clean, and git -c,
which runs any program you name - and in auto mode an allow rule is applied before the classifier.
ask: anything that publishes or rewrites shared history. deny: the destructive forms, and secrets.
A Bash deny rule stops the form Claude usually writes, not every spelling of it - it is not a
security boundary. Use the sandbox, or keep the secret off the machine, where that matters.
No defaultMode on purpose: the runtime's own default applies (auto mode on current Claude Code). A
project value overrides every teammate's own choice - set one only to pin a mode for the whole team.
No "agent" on purpose: it would replace Claude Code's system prompt with one agent's brief for every
session. Opt in per session with `claude --agent rd-lead`.
Build/test/run commands are not granted - add the ones you trust, e.g. Bash(npm run *), Bash(make *),
Bash(./gradlew *), Bash(cargo *), Bash(go test *). Hooks: docs/HOOKS.md (none is wired here).
